item.title: Danish government agency to ditch Microsoft software (2025)
item.description:
📝 0Danish government agency to ditch Microsoft software in push for digital independence Denmark’s tech modernization agency plans to replace Microsoft products with open-source software to reduce dependence on U. Stage said that the ministry could revert to Microsoft products if the transition proves too complex. This week, the German state of Schleswig-Holstein said that local government agencies will abandon Microsoft Office tools such as Word and Excel in favor of LibreOffice, while Open-Xchange will replace Microsoft Outlook for email and calendar functions.
🔗 Read more: https://therecord.media/denmark-digital-agency-microsoft-digital-independence

item.title: Show HN: A real-time strategy game that AI agents can play
item.description:
📝 Tournament Setup Every LLM Skirmish tournament consists of five rounds. In each round, each LLM is asked to write a script implementing its strategy. In-context Learning LLM Skirmish tests in-context learning, as each tournament lasts five rounds and models are able to alter strategies between rounds.
🔗 Read more: https://llmskirmish.com/
